label: The Bottleneck
title: Code moves faster. Delivery still takes coordination.
subtitle: An environment. Access. A repeatable way to deploy.
transcript: Your team can write code faster. Getting it into production still takes coordination.

label: The Platform Team
title: Your platform team creates the foundation once.
subtitle: Reusable infrastructure, access, and delivery workflows.
transcript: Your platform team defines reusable environments, access, and delivery workflows. Planton provisions the foundation in dependency order, ready for your developers to use.

label: The Developer
title: Developers use the foundation to ship.
subtitle: Your code and coding agent. Your team’s configured delivery path.
transcript: Developers and their coding agents use that foundation. A change in GitHub triggers the configured pipeline. Planton builds your code and deploys it to development in your cloud.

label: Your Team’s Controls
title: Routine work flows. Your team keeps control.
subtitle: Required approvals stay with your team. Every deployment has a record.
transcript: Routine work becomes repeatable. Where production requires approval, your team decides. Then Planton deploys the same artifact and records the result.

label: The Real Product
title: See what was created. Understand how it fits.
subtitle: Dogfooding, in practice.
transcript: Everyone can see the resources and how they fit together. This is our own self-hosted Planton on G K E, managing Planton SaaS. Dogfooding, in practice.

label: Start With One Service
title: A repeatable path to production.
subtitle: In your cloud.
transcript: Start with one team, one service, one reusable environment. See Planton with your stack. Book a demo.
